name: Gästehaus Schwaighofer
beschreibung:
Peacefully nestled in Niederndorf, Gaestehaus Schwaighofer serves as a delightful home base for exploring the lower Inn valley. Well-kept guestrooms and warm hospitality promise a pleasant stay.

The Zahmer Kaiser range, cycling paths along the river Inn, and Kufstein Fortress are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Schwaighofer in Niederndorf provides countryside peace and comfort in Kufsteinerland.
